method: Eight order-balanced R3 samples across two blocks at 1440x900; startup marks are low-overhead performance marks captured in the candidate runtime.

r2_recorded_regression.diagnosis: R2 put the full authored runtime and map dependency graph on the parser-critical path and retained redundant startup work around map setup/measurement.

implemented_repairs: Dynamic runtime loader lets canonical data and the decision shell become usable without parser-blocking MapLibre, vector, Plotly, and app evaluation.

Initial map work is kept local-first: PMTiles header validation, local glyph/sprite/hillshade style construction, route/layer installation, markers, obstacle-safe padding, and final semantic readiness remain required.
Initial clustering is deferred until after the first fit, cluster handlers are installed once, and first-render map work avoids duplicate listener/refit work.
Decision content renders independently before map completion; map_visual_ready remains a semantic post-install state rather than an early declaration.
